newsitem.title: USA: North Hempstead, N.Y., sells $38 mln of BANs.
newsitem.headline: North Hempstead, N.Y., sells $38 mln of BANs.

text.p: The Town of North Hempstead, N.Y., sold $38 million of bond anticipation notes (BANs), 1997 Series C, through competitive auction.
State Bank of Long Island bought $32 million of the notes in five pieces:
-- $10 million with a 4.5 percent coupon and a net interest cost of 3.8400 percent.
-- $10 million with 4.5 percent coupon and 3.9800 percent net interest cost.
-- $5 million with a 4.5 percent coupon and 4.0300 percent net interest cost.
-- $5 million with a 4.5 percent coupon and 4.0700 percent net interest cost.
-- $2.024 million with a 4.5 percent coupon and 4.1357 percent net interest cost.
Chase Investment Corp bought $6 million with a 4.375 percent and 4.1110 percent net interest cost.
